item.title: Writer称新模型Palmyra X6将AI代理成本降低52%，正逢token支出激增
item.summary: Writer, the enterprise AI agent platform used by Fortune 500 companies including Accenture, Uber, and Vanguard, released its new flagship model Palmyra X6 today, alongside a rebuilt agent orchestration "harness" and new governance tools designed to give IT leaders control over runaway token spending.
